remarks: In the heart of downtown Stamford! Renovated spacious & sunny 4th floor unit. Large studio with a kitchen alcove with stainless steel appliances and gas range. Full bath with tub. Multi generous closet space. Heat, hot water and cooking gas included.  Laundry and storage in basement. Tenant pays non-refundable credit/application fee, electricity and liability and renters' insurance. Convenient to all major routes and amenities, shops, restaurants, theaters, bus line, etc. Spacious, sun-filled light and bright ~ move in, unpack and enjoy the vibes of City life!
